project_summary: B2B payment orchestration platform with multi-currency settlement and webhook notifications

components.name: Payment gateway abstraction layer
components.description: Unified adapter pattern for Stripe, Adyen, and SEPA direct debit with idempotent charge creation and automatic retry policies.

components.name: Multi-currency settlement engine
components.description: Real-time FX rate ingestion, ledger entries per currency, and end-of-day reconciliation reports for treasury teams.

components.name: Webhook delivery service
components.description: Signed outbound webhooks with exponential backoff, dead-letter queue, and merchant-facing delivery status dashboard.

components.name: Merchant self-service portal
components.description: React SPA for API key management, transaction search, and payout configuration with role-based access control.

components.name: PCI-DSS compliance hardening
components.description: Network segmentation documentation, tokenization of card data, and automated vulnerability scanning in CI pipeline.
